## Lam Research posts record results; market questions whether AI-driven upside is already priced in

Record LRCX results confirm equipment spending strength, but the valuation question is the central risk for semi-equipment positions — the PM needs to assess whether the AI capex cycle has further legs vs. whether multiples have run ahead of remaining upside.

- LRCX reported record results, validating peak-cycle semiconductor equipment demand
- The coverage raises the valuation question: whether AI-driven upside is already reflected in the stock price
- Record results confirm the semiconductor equipment spending cycle remains robust
- The 'already priced in' debate is characteristic of late-cycle positioning and could limit near-term upside
